name: progress
doc: A timed bar or ring. Superset of ox progressBar / progressCircle, QBCore Progressbar and esx_progressbar. Animation, props and interruptions (death, ragdoll, cuffs) stay with the caller's Lua: it cancels. Drawn by `meter` or `progress-ring`. Resolves true when it ran out, false when cancelled.

position.doc: bottom: the bottom band. center: the middle of the screen.

cancel.doc: The player may cancel with `cancelKey`; the caller's Lua reads the key and calls cancel (the page can't read keys without focus).

cancelKey.doc: Shown next to the bar when `cancel` is true.

value.doc: Drive it yourself (update) instead of `duration`'s clock. The clock stops once a value is given.

showPercent.doc: Default: true for ring, false for bar.
